title: Charon ferryman myth comes from the Epic of Gilgamesh

plain: In Greek myth, Charon is the ferryman who carries the dead across the river Styx into the underworld. A researcher of ancient history named Matt LaCroix says this image came from the Epic of Gilgamesh, an ancient poem from Mesopotamia, which he calls "the oldest recorded record of that." He gives no further source beyond a work called The Epic of Humanity, and he tells it to show that later myths borrowed from much older stories.
